capabilities: insert a LaTeX environment at the cursor or around a selection
change the name of the surrounding environment
extras: Internals were rewritten for version 0.3.0 to support Live Preview, and the author asks users to report regressions from 0.2.0; the three commands have no default hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian's math support has no quick way to create, rename, or remove LaTeX environments like \begin...\end blocks without typing them manually.
summary: Adds commands to insert, rename, and delete LaTeX environments inside math blocks, including wrapping the current selection.
